instruction: Please change my default search engine in Chrome to Bing instead of Google.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the default search engine in Chrome from Google to Bing. The evaluator uses a custom getter function get_chrome_search_engine__26a050291c58f47430d6ebca143c45ff which reads Chrome's Preferences file and extracts the search engine name from 'default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name'. The expected value is 'Bing' indicating Bing should be set as the default search engine. Similar to the original task, this requires navigating Chrome settings (Settings > Search engine > Manage search engines) and is of similar difficulty level.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - both tasks involve configuring Chrome settings through the settings interface

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts the default search engine name from Chrome's Preferences file at the appropriate JSON path (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Expected value 'Bing' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are written to disk and can be read
Metric function (exact_match) is appropriate for verifying search engine name
Getter includes cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux) with correct file paths for each OS
Complete coverage - evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Error handling is appropriate with fallback to 'Google' on read failures (which would correctly fail the test)
